units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 9:9">Tosef. Ḥull. IX, 9</cite> <he>לקח הימנו במ׳</he> if he bought of him by the weight.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:10">B. Bath. V, 10</cite> <he>על כל מ׳ ומ׳</he> as often as he uses the weights; Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VIII <he>על כל מ׳ מ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:10">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:35">Lev. XIX, 35</cite>), v. <cite ref="I00229"><he>טוּרְטִינִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Keritot 5a:95">Ker. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>לא יניח מ׳ במ׳ וכ׳</he> he must not use one weighed species as a weight for the other; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִשְׁקָלוֹת</he>. Sifra. l. c.; B. Bath. l. c.; v. <cite ref="M00809"><he>מָחָה</he></cite>. Tunḥ. Balak 12 <he>מְעַוֵּל ומשקר במ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M02081"><he>מעולה</he></cite>) committing wrong and fraud in weights; ib. <he>משקר במ׳</he> using false weights; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 765:30">Yalk. Num. 765</cite>; a. fr.
